scope: Static format and reference checks on the installed AppleBCMWLAN DriverKit bundle.

signpost_argument_labels.method: Parse the plist and identify argument tables with the selected case-insensitive boundary-delimited markers. Compare the labeled values byte for byte with complete NUL-terminated C strings. Use Apple dyld_info to check constant-data rebase targets in each slice.
signpost_argument_labels.interpretation: The selected TWT and PROXD labels occur in the same diagnostic argument map and are referenced by compiled constant data.

section_and_reference_method.marker_scope: Use the printable ASCII run and case-insensitive alphanumeric-boundary rule from the previous timing evidence. For reference matching, use complete NUL-terminated strings in the declared C string section. The four extra RTT matches in arm64e.x1 instruction bytes are printable runs outside the C string section.
section_and_reference_method.reference_scope: Check direct ADR string references and ADRP plus ADD string address formation within each function. Stop the paired search before a direct branch or call and within eight following instructions. Confirm the two PROXD references in each slice with LLVM objdump and its literal annotations. Group the references using the Mach-O function start deltas.
section_and_reference_method.ftm_status_template_selection: Select C strings with a boundary-delimited FTM marker and at least one of the separate words status, ranging, peer or RTT.
section_and_reference_method.local_model_scope: Within the single containing routine per slice, check direct references to C strings containing case-insensitive boundary-delimited 4378, cfg4378, shikoku, honshu, capri or kyushu. Check single low-halfword move-wide forms for chip number 4378 in decimal or hexadecimal and the documented PCI device number 4425 in hexadecimal.
section_and_reference_method.interpretation: The PROXD templates have separate integer fields labeled status and supported. Their direct references place them alongside FTM ranging-status diagnostics. The argument producers, other eligibility paths and actual runtime values remain unresolved.

macos_platform_profile_structure.interpretation: The parsed keys and the selected ASCII search provide no named feature setting in these profiles. The binary Data layout and any encoded feature bits remain unknown.

conclusion: The stock driver includes TWT diagnostic labels and PROXD support-reporting formats associated with ranging code in both architecture slices. BCM4378 eligibility for FTM or TWT remains unverified.
